fusions.name: Drowning Roll
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Clamps on and rolls it under for 24 damage, adding 1.5 times the remaining damage of every affliction you have on it and using them up, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: The Wait Ends
fusions.desc: Lunges you to a target up to 5 tiles away, then bites for 13 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Floating Log
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 65% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Basking Whole
fusions.desc: The moment you are back at full health, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
